issuing_body: National Information Society Agency (NIA), South Korea
implementation_notes: This is a casebook documenting pilot/proof-of-concept AI service implementations across Korean public sector agencies under three strategic goals: social problem solving, public service innovation, and improving administrative work methods. Cases span 2023-2025 and involve large language model fine-tuning, RAG architectures, and multimodal AI. No binding obligations, prohibitions, or enforcement mechanisms are established; the document serves as a knowledge-sharing and demonstration resource.
